rounds.notes:
This is probably Ana's worst round, as there aren't any options to really help with your mobility, and you can't yet afford [Potent Projectiles](item_7e9a8017-9458-4318-aea9-5e80ba7e3c46). Play safe and like you normally would in core gamemodes. Typically, this is the round I most often scope in, as it makes hitting headshots (and shots in general) easier, either on the enemy or your teammates. 

---

### POWERS
[Pinpoint Prescription](item_5cfa07d8-7b5d-42df-a9a8-c6a580acb8bc) has a pretty high skill ceiling, but even inconsistent headshots can do a shocking amount of damage or healing. With no [Weapon Power](stat_weapon_power), that's 150 dmg, which you would normally NOT expect from an Ana. You can get kills from this when people think they're safe, OR, heal your critical tank for 300 damage in two seconds without using a cooldown. 

That being said, if you don't see yourself hitting crits any time soon, (often relatable), then [No Scope Needed](item_823db5eb-5a24-4bac-b850-0aa34e76b4f6) is also a pretty good power, and all you have to do is hit people at all to be effective with it. Though, this will change your build up a little bit, at least regards to item choices. 

---

### ITEMS
Because of your high dps/heal potential with crits, and because Ana is often a prime target for dive heroes, I tend to take the two 25 hp items first round. However, taking one and then some [Attack Speed](stat_attack_speed)/[Weapon Power](stat_weapon_power) is also fine. 

Though, if you chose [No Scope Needed](item_823db5eb-5a24-4bac-b850-0aa34e76b4f6) as your power, ALWAYS take [Ammo Reserves](item_982d53aa-5ef4-493f-93e7-9e374d0ebf34), it helps you out a ton.

round_upgrades.notes: ALWAYS take this if you took no scope needed

rounds.notes:
Now things get much more fun!

You have some mobility and can heal pretty consistently without having to scope in and be a sitting duck. You can play a lot more midrange now if you want, though don't forget you're still pretty squishy. 

---

[Potent Projectiles](item_7e9a8017-9458-4318-aea9-5e80ba7e3c46) and [Dash Boots](item_1ec670c7-a465-4ca0-9d16-aeeedab7894e) almost feel like must-picks on any Ana build. You aren't limited to being a sniper because now you can hit your shots without scoping in a lot more consistently, and you're more mobile so you don't feel like such a easy target. Don't ever sell these items, even if you have enough cash for every most expensive purple available. 

Also, these items can help you when you need to run around the corner to chase your tank that went out of your LoS despite being critical and your other support still running back from spawn; as per my own (unwilling) testing...

Now you start to really become a problem for the enemy to deal with, as you can either be doing great healing and damage from range or close to the fight, and they can try to dive you, but your increased healthpool and hard-to-*miss* sleeps make you a lot more difficult to take down. Plus, if you sleep a squishy and don't get help, you can easily headshot them when waking them up for a lot more damage. 

---

### POWERS
Most of the time, I'd recommend taking [Sleep Regimen](item_28934e4f-0668-482e-b10d-a5d557cc3b1e), as 200 extra health on Ana is just so dang good. Especially so since there are a lot of dive heroes about, and the less mobile a character, the more likely they'll be a target for dives. Plus, with the item we take this round, it'll make hitting sleeps a LOT easier!

(If you *don't* take it this round, thankfully the HP you get based on the number of sleeps you've gotten is retroactive, and so when you take it in round 5 you'll probably get close to the max HP right away)

However, in the rarer games where the enemy team doesn't have heroes that can easily attack or go for an Ana, and thus the extra HP doesn't feel as necessary, then getting [Our Turn](item_6e0fdb41-c00f-41d9-8ec2-1246b34a539a) early on can be a huge boon for your team. We won't really be getting any of the items that boost nano's duration or the ability to cast it through walls, but even getting a nano on ~3 of your teammates can make a heck of a difference in a fight. Sometimes it makes nano feel like a "Press Q to win fight" button. 

"If it's so good, why not take it consistently, then?" You only get nano so often in a game, especially with shorter rounds like in stadium. It's quite powerful, yes, but getting powers where you'll find more consistent use out of through healing/dps, extra hp, or better survivability for you and your team, is usually better than just going all-in on something that only affects your ult. 

---

### ITEMS
Even before it got an additional *10% CDR* added to it, [Tranquilizer](item_2bea20a0-21c0-4a52-b81e-596c17d184b4) was really good. Now, it's great (even more so with fast & skinny, hard to hit characters like [Tracer](hero_bcc3aeb4-369e-4abb-b686-3234c169d37a) in the mix)! I recommend going in the practice range just to get an idea of how forgiving the radis is on your sleep dart now; it's *large*. It makes it possible to pretty consistently get sleeps even on someone flying in the sky, and can even let you do things like sleep a Mercy trying to rez behind a corner. 

That being said, if you don't have anyone you think sleeping would be useful for, or if you're really broke, then getting the optional items instead this round is fine. I would recommend picking up [Tranquilizer](item_2bea20a0-21c0-4a52-b81e-596c17d184b4) in a later round, though, especially whenever you get [Sleep Regimen](item_28934e4f-0668-482e-b10d-a5d557cc3b1e).

round_upgrades.notes: if you're not facing any divers then this IS an option to take early, but you will end up more fragile

rounds.notes:
Not a whole lot of changes to how you play this round, but having a bit more survivability for yourself with your nade is nice. 

---

Adding [I.V. Drip](item_4993e9c9-738f-4aba-bfbf-c6247ff71af1) for the round until we get our next power, and some [Weapon Power](stat_weapon_power), which is always nice to have. 

If the enemy team has a bunch of negative effects to deal with, (Burning from [Ashe](hero_37b42a2d-a82d-4a22-9df2-4c812c873b54), abilities with [Cybervenom](item_210a8582-91ec-4cf3-968a-a443f3a0c505), etc.), then taking [Cushioned Padding](item_20f2f4bc-4611-4d1f-b653-20f04d56b96f) over [I.V. Drip](item_4993e9c9-738f-4aba-bfbf-c6247ff71af1) isn't a bad idea. Keep in mind this also makes the duration you're affected by things like [Sleep Dart](ability_a341654f-02c3-44b4-8fa9-3b2e655650b8) or [Earthshatter](ability_f8f0fa28-b544-4a28-b074-146e7087fc3a) less as well! (And so is something the enemy might take against you, as an Ana)

round_upgrades.notes: i recommend taking this if you're facing enemies w a lot of negative effects

rounds.notes:
With [Home Remedy](item_de68ba66-26d5-4136-a0c1-6396d3f1b0c7) and [Cluster Core](item_c63cd7ba-b71c-4503-bdb6-4ef0b0a4bdbb) under your belt, you now have the ability to keep your team alive through stadium's bull even more! Also, this is when you can start to get a little more cocky with your positioning, as both yourself as an extra body for your nade and the added overhealth you get lets you survive through a lot more. 

---

### POWERS
Take [Home Remedy](item_de68ba66-26d5-4136-a0c1-6396d3f1b0c7) this round, the only exception being if you don't have [Sleep Regimen](item_28934e4f-0668-482e-b10d-a5d557cc3b1e) yet. The extra HP for you is often better that the overhealth, unless your team really groups up a lot and there aren't shields or things that can block your nade. 

By itself, [Home Remedy](item_de68ba66-26d5-4136-a0c1-6396d3f1b0c7) only seems so useful, but it really can come in clutch saving your team - a critical tank suddenly gaining overhealth and boosted healing can quickly make them full health once again. 

---

### ITEMS
[Cluster Core](item_c63cd7ba-b71c-4503-bdb6-4ef0b0a4bdbb) is your new friend. Even hitting three people with it can change your nade from a 13s cooldown to 7s. Imagine if Ana had ber biotic grenade on a 7s cooldown all the time, it would be a nightmare for everyone else. This is also why it can be useful to put yourself in the fight more often now, or at least jump in for a moment when your nade is up and make sure it affects you. 

Other than that, adding in some [Weapon Power](stat_weapon_power). 

If you don't have [Home Remedy](item_de68ba66-26d5-4136-a0c1-6396d3f1b0c7), or just have an exorbitant amount of money to replace just [Talon Modification Module](item_c0ca1795-a3ea-4dc9-ae17-f34122574b3a), then [Cluster Core](item_c63cd7ba-b71c-4503-bdb6-4ef0b0a4bdbb) becomes a lot less useful for your build. You can take it if you want, or pick up [Amari's Antidote](item_67e0b1c5-3bcb-4ab5-b818-5082e5706124) for better healing.

round_upgrades.notes: take this if you don't have it yet

rounds.notes:
From now on we mostly just make it more and more difficult for you and your team to die, while also doing more and more damage. 

---

[Amari's Antidote](item_67e0b1c5-3bcb-4ab5-b818-5082e5706124) gives us even better healing output, not even accounting for bionade's extra healing or hitting headshots. 

However, if you took [No Scope Needed](item_823db5eb-5a24-4bac-b850-0aa34e76b4f6), grab [Unscoped Resources](item_64c401f6-7508-4fc7-ac3a-93c9f3f57e2b) instead, as it makes you have to reload WAY less than before, something which can be annoying to deal with with that power.

round_upgrades.notes: this becomes MANDATORY if you took no scope needed round 1

rounds.notes:
The final build!

Decent mobility and survivability along with easy to hit abilities making you really annoying to take down, combined with good healing/dps and an ult that can boost your entire team makes you a terrible force to be reckoned with.

---

### POWERS
[Our Turn](item_6e0fdb41-c00f-41d9-8ec2-1246b34a539a) is the power that's most consistently valuable in any match, as being able to boost your whole team is amazing, but there are some other good choices as well that are more team-comp dependent. 
- [Time Out](item_34fc2f6c-ecd9-489e-98ca-d08f3eb2fac1): This is something I like to take if the enemy doesn't have team cleanses or a bunch of self-cleanses, (So don't take against a [Kiriko](hero_70a0ac5c-2a55-4fab-beeb-2f570886426f), [Zarya](hero_be6cc516-0b7a-4515-8472-f489f08993b0) or [Moira](hero_7fb6ff1e-a193-40c0-bd0a-25c1928fbaed) with [Voidhoppers](item_d4ce0c76-2500-40d6-b066-dca303be097f), and sometimes if most of the enemy have taken [Cushioned Padding](item_20f2f4bc-4611-4d1f-b653-20f04d56b96f). With [Cluster Core](item_c63cd7ba-b71c-4503-bdb6-4ef0b0a4bdbb), this can be a really strong power, but it's also worth considering that even without cleanses this becomes harder to get value out of if the enemy has barriers to block off your nade, or [Defense Matrix](ability_88831f83-b0fd-434b-92f5-afdc1d809da2) to eat it. That being said, in the right circumstances, this power is great! But as it is and with our build, it becomes pretty situational when to take it, even in in round 7. 
- [My Turn](item_5cea2ccb-c889-4447-8a84-c704c1da1521): This is a good alternative power to grab either if you already have [Our Turn](item_6e0fdb41-c00f-41d9-8ec2-1246b34a539a), or if you feel like you need better self-survivability. Remember this is the perk that was so good in core gamemode that they removed it, except that one had 50% duration, rather than [My Turn](item_5cea2ccb-c889-4447-8a84-c704c1da1521)'s 100%. 
- [Your Full Potential](item_f03b3a26-0d1b-46bc-85e6-92f060b53b4e): I usually wouldn't consider taking this if I didn't already have [Our Turn](item_6e0fdb41-c00f-41d9-8ec2-1246b34a539a), but if most of your team won't be likely to get much value out of being nano-d, or there's one teammate that's really popping off/you want to super boost with your ult, then this can be pretty useful. 

---

### ITEMS
Thankfully, due to keeping two rare items, you'll *probably* have enough for the full build even if you don't have the highest cash in the lobby.

This round's item choices are a little more up in the air compared to the rest of the build, as your final two items (the ones not marked with a star as Important) can vary between what you might want on a match to match basis. If you take the recommend build, it's the best combo you'll get for dps/healing output, as the optional items are mostly based around better survivability, but still, they're worth considering. 

Quick summaries of why/when you'd want the items:
- [Nebula Conduit](item_476b7040-54c9-4f0c-8283-b4407f6809f8): A decent survivability option for taking less burst dmg, though not *as* strong without a way to heal that back, either through your co-support helping you, using nade on yourself, or the next two options below. 
- [Phantasmic Flux](item_5e644a79-cf6e-4196-8d0a-232f75004643): 15% isn't a whole lot of lifesteal, but it can mean the difference of surviving or dying to someone diving you. Works especially well for survivability combined with [Nebula Conduit](item_476b7040-54c9-4f0c-8283-b4407f6809f8), but if you don't see yourself doing damage much in a fight, consider taking the next option (though you won't be getting any [Weapon Power](stat_weapon_power) from it). 
- [Martian Mender](item_0099632b-4e18-450e-844f-22c40e51bc98): One of the pure survivability options, since it has no [Weapon Power](stat_weapon_power). Due to your larger health pool, the % passive heal is decent, and better CDR is always good. 
- [Eye of Horus](item_169551ce-e4e5-4a14-9ec4-abdc25673939): This pretty much just boosts either [Our Turn](item_6e0fdb41-c00f-41d9-8ec2-1246b34a539a) and/or [Your Full Potential](item_f03b3a26-0d1b-46bc-85e6-92f060b53b4e). If you don't have either, this isn't worth taking, and only worth considering if you do, as you'll be giving up a really good [Weapon Power](stat_weapon_power) item for it, and more WP means more healing and damage for faster nanos in general. However, if you have both powers it really does make them pack a punch.

round_upgrades.notes: only consider taking this if you have Our Turn and/or Your Full Potential
